title: SiliconGym: A Versatile Reinforcement Learning Environment for Agentic EDA
abstract: arXiv:2611.25658v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Reinforcement learning (RL) with electronic design automation (EDA) feedback is advancing large language models for hardware design and verification. Extending these gains to hardware-engineering agents requires environments that span tasks, preserve state across tool calls, and support large hierarchies alongside parallel rollouts. We present SiliconGym, the first versatile, cross-task and cross-toolchain RL environment for hardware design and verification. By decoupling versioned workspaces, budgeted execution, and acceptance-gated scoring, SiliconGym scales from module-level RTL, testbench, and PPA tasks to multi-round repository repair and full-hierarchy SoC flows. Streaming dispatch overlaps tool checks with generation, finishing a 256-answer RL batch 21.9% faster than native ChipSeek. translated_title: SiliconGym：面向智能体化EDA的多功能强化学习环境
translated_abstract: 利用电子设计自动化（EDA）反馈的强化学习（RL）正在推动硬件设计与验证领域大语言模型的发展。要将这些成果扩展到硬件工程智能体，需要能够跨越多种任务、在工具调用之间保持状态，并同时支持大型层次结构与并行回合的环境。我们提出了SiliconGym，这是首个面向硬件设计与验证的多功能、跨任务、跨工具链的强化学习环境。通过解耦版本化工作区、预算化执行和验收门控评分，SiliconGym能够从模块级的RTL、测试平台和PPA任务，扩展到多轮代码仓库修复以及全层次SoC流程。流式调度将工具检查与生成过程重叠，使一个包含256个答案的RL批次的完成速度比原生ChipSeek快21.9%。借助可互换的开源与商业后端，我们证明了在开源工具上训练获得的功能正确性可以顺利迁移到商业si（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 本文提出SiliconGym，首个面向硬件设计与验证的跨任务、跨工具链强化学习环境，通过解耦版本化工作区、预算化执行与验收门控评分，实现从模块级RTL任务到全层次SoC流程的可扩展训练，并借助流式调度将RL批次完成速度提升21.9%。
en_tdlr: SiliconGym is the first versatile cross-task and cross-toolchain RL environment for hardware design and verification, scaling from module-level RTL tasks to full-hierarchy SoC flows through decoupled versioned workspaces, budgeted execution, and acceptance-gated scoring, with streaming dispatch finishing RL batches 21.9% faster than native ChipSeek.
